update_procedure: Read the governing AGENTS.md and this ledger before using older handoffs.
Re-verify branch, HEAD, worktree inventory, source hashes, environment identity and required evidence before every update.
Change generated_at and only claims supported by a named evidence artifact and explicit evidence level.
Keep accepted gates closed unless contradictory evidence is recorded; never promote source/synthetic evidence to runtime acceptance.
Track every migration separately for Local Development, isolated lab, Staging and Production; Git deployment never implies database application.
Keep secrets, payloads, customer/provider identifiers, private evidence paths/hashes and raw exceptions out of this ledger.
Use a surgical edit with exact preconditions and postflight validation; preserve VS Code as editor of record and GitHub as remote source of truth.
fail_closed_rules: STOP on any branch, HEAD, source hash, migration, environment, database, sandbox-account or worktree mismatch.
STOP if the target database is not exactly the separately authorized environment.
STOP on live-mode credentials, a non-isolated endpoint, ambiguous ownership, missing price mapping, another active paid rail or conflicting stored evidence.
STOP after the first ambiguous HTTP outcome or exception; do not retry, replay, repair or clean up financial state without a new authorization.
STOP if a received event, receipt, entitlement, paid-through boundary and event completion do not agree atomically.
STOP if evidence collection would disclose a secret, signature, payload, provider/customer identifier, DSN or private evidence location.

R2 and R3 are accepted only within their recorded Local scopes. Never redeliver the processed R2 invoice. Real overdue recovery, Production retry ownership and remote acceptance require separate verification and authorization.
